title: 第14章 擂台第15章 火山
content_zh:
于峰从桌上拿起一张雷龙酒吧的赛程表，看着标了星号的那一天，眉头隐约蹙起。
“张耀还没到拿合约的时候吧？”
躺在椅子里的疤脸翻了翻白眼
“没办法，他姐姐天天在我耳朵边上蛐蛐蛐蛐的，烦人得很！但她确实活儿好，人还润，整得我怪上头。”
他把手伸到裤裆里拨弄了一下，拿出来在鼻子边闻了闻，然后朝着于峰屈指一弹
“反正张耀也练这么久了。给他造造势，安排个准备退休的签约拳手，完了让他拿钱买地龙肉，破关应该也差不多。”
于峰面无表情，又看了下张耀的对手
“高磊么，受了伤确实不行了。打死还是怎么说？”
“打死谁？高磊是不行了，那也是对其他签约拳手，拿捏张耀那混小子还是没问题的。我给他说了，让他输好看点，我给他一笔钱，送他回城里。”
于峰挑起眉头
“真的？”
疤脸哈哈大笑，嘲讽道
“老于你傻了吧，咋可能是真的？大老板爱听的那歌怎么说的，什么‘你想啥时候买单就啥时候买单，但你永远别想着溜号’？诶，感觉不大对，怎么唱来着？”
于峰面无表情的看着办公桌后挠头的疤脸，看着这个园区的二老板，周虎。
他一头钢针般的板寸染成白色，线条冷硬的脸上黑眼圈极重，左眼睑下方，有一道斜斜延伸到下巴的狰狞刀疤，刀疤切过嘴角，让他左边的嘴角向下吊着，似乎永远带着冷笑。
寒冬时节，周虎也只穿着一件敞开的无袖皮夹克，露出脖子上的尖刺项链、胸口的虎头刺青，以及两条健硕到夸张的花臂。
他的黑色皮裤扎进同色的大皮靴里，大脚在桌上嚣张的抖啊抖，看着于峰的表情似笑非笑。
“怎么，觉得高磊是你教出来的？准备提前告诉他？”
于峰淡淡道
“他又不是我徒弟。”

“哦，真是冷血的于教练。行了，最近你不是操练了几个暖场的？能用了吧？”
于峰眉头动了动
“还不行。噱头不是张耀逆袭签约拳手吗？还要暖场的干什么。”
“还不行？我看老于你才是越来越不行了。”
周虎不满道
“我怕那混小子打的不好看，或者高磊演得不出力，先来几个暖场的炒炒气氛。”
“那几个……大多都练得一般。”
周虎微微皱眉
“那没意思。”
他思考了一会儿，一拍桌子
“还是让他们上，意思意思得了。我让张耀利落点儿，也不用搞虐杀什么的。”
于峰表情微松，点了点头。
周虎瞄着他，忽然道
“老于，不会心疼你的徒弟吧？”
于峰看着他，冷冷道
“再说一遍，这儿没有我的徒弟。
“我的徒弟，早就死光了。”
感受着于峰骤然变冷的眼神，周虎笑了笑，挥挥手示意他离开。
……
一辆商务车缓缓从园区里驶到大铁门前。

看守走到驾驶座旁，扫了眼司机递出的通行许可，又数了下车里的人，这才挥手放行。
大铁门缓缓拉开，武装哨卫冰冷的眼神俯视着商务车在坑坑包包的路上远去。
车里，陈冲靠在窗边上，看着两边灰黑的矮楼棚户不断后退。冬季傍晚的天空早已暗沉，路灯是两排沉默的影子守卫，楼房里只有隐约的灯光快速划过，橘黄色的卤素灯成了街上唯一的光源，在这片寂静里慢慢往前行去。
content_en:
Yu Feng picked up a schedule of the Brontosaurus Bar from the table, looked at the day marked with an asterisk, and frowned vaguely.
"It's not time for Zhang Yao to get the contract, right?"
Scarface, who was lying in the chair, rolled his eyes.
"I can't help it. His sister is playing crickets in my ears every day. It's very annoying! But she does a good job and is kind-hearted. I blame her for it."
He put his hand into his crotch and fiddled with it, took it out to his nose and smelled it, then flicked it towards Yu Feng
"Anyway, Zhang Yao has been training for so long. Build momentum for him, arrange a contract with a boxer who is ready to retire, and then let him use the money to buy earth dragon meat. It should be almost the same as breaking through."
Yu Feng had no expression on his face and looked at Zhang Yao's opponent again.
"Gao Lei, you are really injured and can't survive. Beat him to death or what?"
"Who should I beat to death? Gao Lei is dying. That's also true for other contracted boxers. It's okay to deal with that bastard Zhang Yao. I told him to make his loss look good. I'll give him a sum of money and send him back to the city."
Yu Feng raised his eyebrows
"Really?"
Scarface laughed and mocked
"Are you stupid, Lao Yu? How could it be true? What does the song that the big boss likes to listen to say, 'You can pay when you want, but you can never think about quitting'? Hey, it doesn't feel right, why are you singing it?"
Yu Feng looked expressionlessly at Scarface scratching his head behind the desk, and at the second boss of the park, Zhou Hu.
His hair was dyed white like a steel needle, and his cold-faced face had heavy dark circles. Under his left eyelid, there was a ferocious scar extending diagonally to his chin. The scar cut across the corner of his mouth, causing the left corner of his mouth to hang downward, as if he was always wearing a sneer.
In the cold winter, Zhou Hu only wore an open sleeveless leather jacket, revealing the spiked necklace around his neck, the tiger head tattoo on his chest, and his two exaggeratedly muscular arms.
His black leather pants were tucked into big leather boots of the same color, and his big feet were shaking arrogantly on the table. Looking at Yu Feng's expression, he seemed to be smiling but not smiling.
"What, do you think Gao Lei was taught by you? Are you going to tell him in advance?"
Yu Feng said calmly
"He is not my apprentice."
"Oh, Coach Yu is really cold-blooded. Okay, haven't you practiced a few warm-ups recently? Can it be used?"
Yu Feng's brows moved.
"Not yet. Isn't the gimmick that Zhang Yao counterattacks the contracted boxer? Why do you need to warm up the show?"
"It's still not working? I think it's Lao Yu who is getting worse and worse."
Zhou Hu said dissatisfied
"I'm afraid that the bastard won't be good at playing, or Gao Lei won't be effective in his acting, so I'll do some warm-up first to stir up the atmosphere."
"Those few... most of them are average in training."
Zhou Hu frowned slightly
"That's not interesting."
He thought for a while and then slapped the table
"It's better to let them go, it's cool. I'll let Zhang Yao be more careful, and there's no need to engage in torture or anything like that."
Yu Feng's expression was slightly relaxed and he nodded.
Zhou Hu looked at him and suddenly said
"Lao Yu, you don't feel sorry for your apprentice, do you?"
Yu Feng looked at him and said coldly
“Again, I don’t have any apprentices here.
"All my disciples have died long ago. "
Feeling Yu Feng's suddenly cold eyes, Zhou Hu smiled and waved for him to leave.

A commercial vehicle slowly drove from the park to the big iron gate.
The guard walked to the driver's seat, glanced at the pass issued by the driver, counted the people in the car, and then waved to let him go.
The large iron door slowly opened, and the armed sentry looked down at the commercial vehicle with cold eyes as it drove away on the bumpy road.
In the car, Chen Chong leaned against the window and watched the gray and black low-rise shacks on both sides receding. The sky in the winter evening has long been dark, and the street lamps are two rows of silent shadow guards. Only the faint lights in the buildings are passing quickly. The orange halogen lamps have become the only light source on the street. I slowly move forward in this silence.
